content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 7.7 was the only Customer-payable liquidated damages provision in the agreement (15% of annual Fees per week for a late invoice) — a minor-breach trigger that can quickly exceed remaining contract value, so it fails the fallback and sits in walk-away territory. No early-termination fee or minimum-fee-on-termination exists elsewhere (§ 9.4 requires only accrued Fees with a prepaid refund; § 27 termination is "without penalty"), so the preferred position was achievable. I replaced only the offending formula with an unconditional statement that Customer owes no liquidated damages or penalties, preserving the rest of § 7.
